component.name: lost-commander
component.summary: Dual-pane file manager in the Norton Commander tradition

description.p: A file manager with two directory panels side by side: one where things are, one where they are going. Copy, move, delete and compare run with live progress and can be cancelled; archives open as directories; and an account is kept of what was done.

Each pane can be a dense detail list, a grid of large icons, the directory tree above its files, or a quick view of whatever the other pane is pointing at. Text, markdown, images and raw bytes all preview in place, and bytes can be edited.
There is a terminal front-end as well, called lostc, over exactly the same engine.

ul.li: Folder compare and synchronise, and a duplicate finder
Find by name and by contents
A real shell in a drawer, with its commands recorded
Reading zip, tar, 7z and lha archives
